_note: 2026 general-election candidates for State Senate and State House in Michigan, Tennessee and Vermont, read from each state's official candidate list on 2026-10-28; Mississippi elects its Legislature in 2027 and its official list carries no legislative contest. "rows" are new cmp-data.js candidate rows (candidate: true; they open no board). "alreadyHeld" are sitting legislators running for the seat they hold: their row is the roster row. "crossSeat" are sitting legislators running for a different legislative seat: their row is untouched and window.CMP_CANDIDACIES carries the candidacy. Michigan candidates the listing marks DISQ or WITHD are excluded ("excluded"). Vermont's list prints names in capitals; nameAsFiled keeps that and the roster row gives the name in title case. Vermont's two- and three-member districts list every candidate for the district; a sitting member is matched by name within the district.

ms.note: Mississippi SOS Candidate Qualifying List ('all offices and candidates currently on file'): U.S. Senate, U.S. House and judicial offices only. The Legislature is elected in odd years (next 2027), and no legislative special election is on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

mi.note: Michigan Bureau of Elections 'Official Candidate Listing - All State and Judicial Offices, General Election Tuesday, November 3, 2026' (entellitrak public report, as of 2026-10-27), State Senator and Representative in State Legislature entries. Names composed First Last Suffix from the listing's 'Last, First' form. Excluded: Davis, Debra (statehouse 3, DISQ); Simpson, Danetta L. (statehouse 9, DISQ); DeBoyer, Jay (statehouse 63, WITHD).

tn.note: Tennessee Secretary of State, Division of Elections candidate lists for the November 3, 2026 General Election, Tennessee Senate (odd-numbered districts) and Tennessee House of Representatives. House District 93 lists 'No Candidate Qualified'. Brent Taylor (Senate 31) and Justin J. Pearson (House 86) are on these lists for the seat they hold and on the U.S. House list for TN-9; their row is the roster row and the TN-9 candidacy is in CMP_CANDIDACIES.

vt.note: Vermont SOS '2026 General Election Candidate Listing' (qualified candidates xlsx, 'Last Updated: 9/23/2026'), STATE SENATOR and STATE REPRESENTATIVE entries; district codes (ADD 1, CHI SE 1, WDR ORA 2 …) read as the district's name. Party labels as printed (DEM/PROG, REP/DEM … are fusion nominations); `party` is the first-named party when it is Republican or Democratic.
